_about: Sources read 2 October 2026 for the War on Terror records of the war memorial sourcing. NARA's Defense Casualty Analysis System Public Use File (RG 330), read in a browser, covers deaths in the theaters of war to May 2006. Defense Department releases for 2007 to 2011 could not be found by name (defense.gov's release search starts in 2014 and web search does not index the archive); the four deaths outside a theater of war (Wilson, Todd, Conant, Colley) are in neither source.
546 Prosser: PROSSER BRIAN CODY, Army, SSG, Regular, born 07/17/1973, home of record PANARAMA HEIGHTS (county: multiple), hostile action, result of traumatic injuries received during a bomb[ing], Kahneh Gerdab, Afghanistan, D Company, 3 Bn, 5 SFG, 12/05/2001, Operation Enduring Freedom, died of wounds, explosive device
532 Flores-Mejia: FLORES-MEJIA JOSE RICARDO, Army, SPC, Regular, born 07/20/1983, home of record SANTA CLARITA, hostile action, Mosul, Iraq, 25th Transportation Company (13 CC), Schofield Barracks, 11/16/2004, Operation Iraqi Freedom, killed in action, explosive device
530 Slocum: SLOCUM RICHARD PATRICK, Marine Corps, LCPL, Regular, born 02/02/1985, home of record SAUGUS, turret gunner in a government owned HMMWV that was involved in an a[ccident], Abu Gharib, Iraq, Wpns Co, 1st Bn, 3d Mar, (RCT-7, 1st Mar Div), 10/24/2004, Operation Iraqi Freedom, non-hostile, accident, vehicle crash
